decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The display of the advertisement hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of one year from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The design and colour of adverts on the hoarding hereby approved shall not differ from those shown on the submitted and approved drawings unless agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 3 - The advertisements hereby approved shall be fully removed from the site no later than three years after the date of this permission or the sale of the last unit at the developed site, whichever is the sooner.

Condition : 4 - All advertisements displays, and any site used for the display of advertisements shall be maintained in a clean and tidy condition to the reasonable satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - Any structure or hoarding erected or used principally for the purpose of displaying advertisements shall be maintained in a safe condition.
Condition : 6 - Where any advertisement is required under these regulations to be removed, the removal shall be carried out to the reasonable satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 7 - No advertisement is to be displayed without the permission of the owner of the site or any other person with an interest in the site entitled to grant planning permission.

Condition : 8 - No advertisement shall be sited or displayed so as to-
(a) endanger persons using any public highway, railway, waterway, dock, harbour or aerodrome (civil or military);
(b) obscure, or hinder the ready interpretation of, any traffic sign, railway signal or aid to navigation by water or air; or
(c) hinder the operation of any device used for the purpose of security or surveillance or for measuring the speed of any vehicle.
description: Installation and display of a non-illuminated 2.0 m high hoarding with advertisements, three 6m high flag poles with flags, and two 'A' frame signs, 2.5m high and 1.5m wide with 0.9m high flags on top.
